lines: Killshot. An online shooter for up to eight players.
Three hand-authored maps. Eight weapons. Five hit points.
You spawn with a sidearm. The rest you take from the blocks overhead.
Slide, sprint, and kick between the walls.
Version thirty-one adds the Breach-twelve. Six shells, eight pellets each.
Killshot. It runs in your browser.
